comments.author: seer
comments.story: Scientists identify pathways that extend nematode worm lifespan fivefold
comments.why: Concise, fun explanation of anti-aging case.
comments.text: CGP gray's videos on YouTube are maybe the most concise and fun to watch materials I've seen on the subject. [VIDEO] [LINK] And you'll be surprised how many people _are_ indeed thinking about all of the outcomes. Have in mind though that as with any technology it is not good or bad, and if it is possible someone will do it sooner or later. It makes no sense to not do it as your adversaries will, and then they'll dictate how it is used, probably not to your liking. If you develop it first you can talk and deliberate at your leisure and find solutions that look much better to you and yours.
